title: Director, Regional Employee Experience
description:
The Director, Employee Experience India will report to the Head of Regional HR, APAC and will be the face of the People Team to the India employees and managers while serving as the main point of contact for escalated inquiries and concerns, performance management, employee well\-being, employee relations, and compliance. Additionally, this role will proactively and collaboratively, support and partner a local business unit leader and their team, while overseeing and/or directly leading the local Employee Experience team.
   

  

 The Employee Experience Team at MongoDB India is the face of HR to the approximately 800 employees. The team is responsible for providing full employee life cycle service delivery from onboarding to separation management in partnership with the rest of the People Team including the following CoEs: Recruiting, Total Rewards, Learning and Development, Employee Engagement \& Inclusion, HR Business Partnering and HR Operations. The team is also responsible for our Workplace sustainability and community/events efforts, Employee Relations, policy and process enhancements including regional compliance as well as developing programs to enhance manager capability across the company.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Management: Effectively lead India Employee Experience team and manage direct report(s), with effective cadence, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment while actively supporting their professional development
* Partnership: Partner with global HRBPs and COEs to support achieving the people goals of assigned business units in India
* Service Delivery: Serve as the main point of contact for escalated employee and people manager questions and concerns for your assigned business unit and broader India businesses.
* Performance Management: Coach and enable managers to set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and manage employee performance
* Employee Relations: Support our commitment to a safe and balanced workplace by evaluating employee complaints to make appropriate recommendations to address the matter. Conduct mediation sessions when necessary.
* Process Improvement: Develop and evolve MongoDB People processes and systems to continue elevating the employee and manager experience
* Compliance: Stay updated on employment law and current legislation related to Human Resources, providing valuable advice to managers, identifying risks, and suggesting alternative solutions. Contribute to the evaluation, development, and enhancement of company policies as needed
* Culture Ambassador: Focus on manager and leadership enablement; support and promote a values\-based culture and effective hybrid working environment in partnership with Workplace and local leadership
* Coaching: Act as a trusted advisor, applying your HR expertise and understanding of MongoDB’s business to effectively partner with leaders to provide guidance, support, and coaching to drive people development and business results
* Knowledge: Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law


**Requirements**
* Ideally, a Bachelor’s degree in HR or related field with at least 10 years of well\-rounded experience in progressive HR roles with at least 5 years in a leadership position. Must have strong performance management, coaching, business partnership, employee relations, and HR operations background. Experience in a high growth technology business is a plus. Relevant certifications are a double plus
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal and influence skills with the ability to influence and engage others
* Strong understanding and working knowledge of employment laws of India is a must, combined with the proven ability to interpret and guide employment matters, manage grievances, disputes and investigations in alignment with local employment law and regulations
* Passion for and demonstrated expertise in developing and implementing HR programs and driving operational excellence for a high growth and complex company. We are still building the bridge as we walk, and we need someone who has the organizational \& project management skills that are required to do that and enjoys the exhilaration that comes with it
* Critical thinking skills are important. This includes the ability to analyze a situation or problem, identify the root cause, break solutions down into achievable milestones and make informed data\-driven decisions
* Adaptability and flexibility for two reasons \- we are a company that is scaling in a market that is constantly evolving and this role partners with employees at all levels of the organization. You will need to shift regularly between tactical and strategic priorities, deal with a lot of change and focus on driving outcomes across a wide range of levels in the company
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
* You need to be comfortable in an accelerated learning environment and be self\-motivated and assertive to succeed


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform, the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 60,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Manager - Talent Acquisition & HR - (Own Internal Hiring and HR Processes)
job_function: Human Resources, General Business, and Strategy/Planning
description:
Location: Brigade Twin Towers, Yeshwanthpur, Bangalore
 



 Work Mode: Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 Careerxperts Consulting has grown steadily by focusing on one thing \- building the right teams for growing businesses. As we enter our next phase of growth and set up two new offices in Bangalore, we are strengthening our internal team to support scale with structure, quality, and intent.
 



  





 We are now looking for a Manager – Talent Acquisition \& HR who will own internal hiring end\-to\-end and act as the custodian of people, culture, and structure within the organisation. This role sits at the heart of the company and directly influences how we grow, perform, and deliver.
 



  





 The Role
 



 You will be responsible for internal hiring across the entire organisation, while also owning essential HR and people operations.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will personally source, screen, interview, and close candidates \- especially for senior, niche, and high\-impact positions. At the same time, you will ensure the company has strong onboarding, clear policies, and dependable people processes.
 



 You will work closely with leadership to understand how the business is evolving and translate that into sharp hiring decisions and strong people practices.
 



  





 What You’ll Own
 



 Internal Talent Acquisition (Primary Responsibility)
 



 You will lead and execute hiring for roles including (but not limited to):
 



 Technical recruiters, Non\-technical recruiters, Lead recruiters and team managers, Vertical / practice heads, Operations and delivery team, Digital, marketing, and enablement roles or any role that directly contributes to the core of the business
 



  





 Your responsibility is not just filling roles, but ensuring each hire strengthens the company.
 



 This includes:
 


* Deep understanding of role expectations, hiring bar, and cultural fit
* Writing clear, credible, and role\-specific job descriptions that candidates can trust
* Hands\-on sourcing using networks, referrals, platforms, and direct outreach
* Conducting structured interviews that assess capability, intent, and long\-term fit
* Closing candidates with clarity and conviction



  





 Hiring Strategy \& Leadership Partnership
 


* Work closely with founders and leadership to understand current and future hiring needs
* Advise on team structure, role clarity, and hiring priorities
* Maintain hiring discipline without slowing the business down
* Ensure consistent hiring standards across teams and levels



  





 HR \& People Operations
 


* Own onboarding, documentation, policies, and compliance
* Act as a dependable point of contact for employees on people\-related matters
* Bring structure, organisation, and follow\-through to day\-to\-day people operations



  





 Who This Role Is For
 


* You have strong hands\-on experience in internal hiring, preferably in recruitment or staffing companies
* You understand how to hire recruiters, leaders, and support teams effectively
* You are comfortable sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing on your own
* You are organised, dependable, and calm in fast\-moving environments
* You communicate clearly and directly \- with candidates and leadership
* You take ownership naturally and don’t wait to be told what needs to be done
* You care deeply about hiring quality and long\-term fit



  





 What We’re Looking For
 


* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition with exposure to HR operations
* Experience hiring for internal roles within recruitment, staffing, or people\-driven businesses
* Ability to independently manage multiple hires across functions and levels
* Strong stakeholder management and decision\-making skills
* Bangalore\-based and open to working full\-time from office



  





 Why This Role Matters
 



 In a recruitment company, every internal hire reflects the standards we promise our clients.
 



 This role directly shapes:
 


* The strength of our delivery teams
* The quality of leadership across verticals
* The culture and credibility of the organisation



  





 If you care about building teams that actually perform and want to own internal hiring at the heart of a recruitment business, this role will give you both responsibility and impact. Write to himanshu.r@careerxperts.com to get connected

At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision\-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well\-being.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 




 The Manager – Learning will support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of learning programs for our Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru, India. This role is responsible for implementing learning strategies that build associate capability and drive business performance. The position will manage learning operations and partner closely with global and local stakeholders to ensure programs are relevant, high\-quality, and aligned with enterprise priorities.
 



  





**Role Responsibilities:** 




**Learning Strategy \& Planning:** 



* Partner with global and local HR and business leaders to identify learning priorities, skills gaps, and future capability needs.
* Contribute to the development and execution of the GCC learning roadmap, ensuring alignment with global learning goals.
* Support implementation of enterprise\-wide learning initiatives locally.



  





**Needs Assessment:** 



* Conduct and analyze learning needs assessments using surveys, interviews, and performance data.
* Translate business needs into actionable learning solutions in partnership with subject matter experts and global learning teams.



  





**Program Design \& Development:** 



* Design and develop engaging learning content (digital, instructor\-led, blended) using adult learning principles.
* Create course materials, activities, and assessments using instructional design tools and templates.
* Adapt global content for local audiences while maintaining consistency with brand and quality standards.



  





**Delivery \& Facilitation:** 



* Manage delivery logistics for learning programs, including scheduling, coordination with facilitators, and platform setup.
* Facilitate selected in\-person and virtual learning sessions.
* Ensure a positive and consistent learner experience across programs.



  





**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement:** 



* Collect feedback and evaluate learning program effectiveness using defined metrics.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and enhance learning impact over time.



  





**Operations \& Governance:** 



* Manage learning operations, including vendor coordination, budgeting support, and LMS administration.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, accessibility, and corporate learning standards.
* Promote awareness and adoption of available learning resources and tools across the GCC.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* We believe the successful candidate has these qualifications and experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field (master’s preferred).
* 5\+ years of experience in corporate learning, with experience managing or coordinating learning initiatives.
* Experience in a global or GCC environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design, adult learning theory, and modern learning technologies.



  





**Key Competencies:** 



* Strong execution focus with the ability to translate learning strategy into action.
* Excellent facilitation and communication skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with learning management systems, digital learning tools (e.g., Articulate Suite), and virtual delivery platforms; experience with Coursera a plus.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Talent Consultant, Lead Executive**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
* You will act as a talent consultant for a business unit and be a key point of contact with leadership on various people engagement related matters.
* You will build a deep understanding of both the business direction and talent related topics to ensure successful implementation of key, high\-touch people process and initiatives.
* You will also partner closely with the other talent function teams to ensure seamless execution of talent initiatives across the business unit.


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a point of contact for leaders and employees within the business unit
* Drive HR activities for the business units (new initiatives, policies \& strategies)
* Ensure employee engagement, employee satisfaction \& retention for the business unit
* Lead the implementation of engagement initiatives like town halls, and other quarterly meetings
* Work closely with the business unit leads and counsellors on career planning and people development strategies
* Drive attrition analysis for the business and call out any trends through which recommendations can be made to the business to support retention
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Accountable for supporting people strategy initiatives and providing development opportunities to build skills and knowledge
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business is delivered in a timely and professional manner
* Responsible for day to day HR activities and perform them with the right quality as per communicated standards
* Support the development and execution of innovative HR programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business, for example, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong employee relations experience from handling complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities
* Experience of making contribution to business decision making, strategic planning discussions and operational planning events
* Proven ability to influence leaders in the organisation, preferably in a professional services environment
* Good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate. A post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 3 \- 5 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Comfortable working with data and preparation of summaries/storyboards is preferred


**What We Look For**
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion
* Open to working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

 HireRight is the premier global background screening and workforce solutions provider. We bring clarity and confidence to vetting and hiring decisions through integrated, tailored solutions, driving a higher standard of accuracy in everything we do. Combining in\-house talent, personalized services, and proprietary technology, we ensure the best candidate experience possible. PBSA accredited and based in Nashville, TN, we offer expertise from our regional centers across 200 countries and territories in The Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Our commitment to get it right every time, everywhere, makes us the trusted partner of businesses and organizations worldwide.
   

  

**Overview**
 The HR Coordinator will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to the HR team. This role is critical in ensuring smooth execution of HR processes, tracking deliverables, and supporting multiple HR projects. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured manner.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Transactional \& Administrative Support**
* Assist HR teams with day\-to\-day administrative tasks and documentation.
* Prepare and maintain HR records, reports, and trackers.


**Coordination \& Follow\-ups**
* Track agreed tasks and ensure timely closures with relevant teams and individuals.
* Send reminders and follow up on pending actions across HR functions.


**Specific Activities**
* New Hire Onboarding: Coordinate onboarding activities, ensure completion of checklists, and liaise with stakeholders for a smooth experience. Manage the onboarding orientation including the identification and allocation of speakers, run new hire check\-ins as may be defined from time to time.
* Offboarding process: Support all concerned HR teams on offboarding related process and inputs.
* Database Updates \& Accuracy: Work with HRBPs and HR Services to perform monthly HR employee database validations, identify and resolve defects. Work with HRBPs for timely preparation of inputs for any HR database changes.
* Periodic Meetings: Schedule and coordinate meetings with key stakeholders for the HR Head, including agenda preparation and follow\-ups.
* Focus Group Discussions: Identify and confirm participants for HRBP\-led focus group discussions. Organize the meetings, document the feedback/actions and track closures with respective teams within and outside HR.
* Engagement Survey Action Planning: Follow up on periodic activities and ensure timely implementation of agreed actions.
* Compliance Activities: Run checklists for compliance\-related tasks across teams and track completion.
* Process Audits: Conduct basic audits of HR processes to ensure adherence to standards and highlight gaps. Support HR team in collating responses for on\-going audit queries, creating and maintaining a tracker of all audit related action points and tracking before time closure with proper review, approvals and documentation.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Collect, organize, and analyse basic HR data (e.g., headcount, attrition, engagement scores).
* Prepare basic dashboards and summary reports for leadership review.


**Project Coordination**
* Support HR projects by managing timelines, deliverables, and communication.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of initiatives.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR coordination or administrative roles (preferred).
* Strong communication skills (verbal and written).
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with HR systems is a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects with attention to detail and deadlines.
* Structured and organized approach to work with problem\-solving mindset.


**Key Competencies**
* Organizational Skills: Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Analytical Thinking: Comfortable working with data and generating insights.
* Collaboration: Works well with diverse teams and builds strong relationships.
* Proactive Approach: Takes initiative to follow up and ensure task completion.


**What Do We Offer**
 Please submit resume/CV in English.
   

  

 All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.
   

  

 HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

title: Data Review – Specialist (Stability Protocol / Study Build Review)
description:
**Company Description**
 Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment and pharmaceutical products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA.
   

  

 Group's key figures are approx. 6\.95 billion Euros turnover, over 950 laboratories across 60 countries and about 63,000 staff.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary:** 
 Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories is seeking a highly analytical and quality‑driven
 **Data Reviewer Specialist** 
 to ensure accuracy and compliance of all stability protocols and study builds prior to client release. This position plays a crucial role in safeguarding data integrity and ensuring that client expectations are consistently met.
   

  

 This role includes a structured training progression: the individual will be fully trained as a
 **Stability Protocol Writer / Study Builder** 
 prior to performing protocol and study review responsibilities. This ensures a deep understanding of both the technical content and system workflows that impact the quality of client deliveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Training Phase – Protocol Writing \& Study Building**
* Complete comprehensive training in protocol writing based on Eurofins‑generated quotes.
* Learn and practice building stability studies within the LIMS system following client‑provided protocols.
* Develop proficiency in interpreting client requirements, scientific documentation, and stability program workflows.


**Primary Role – Data Review**
* Perform detailed, independent review of stability protocols and study builds to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with client expectations.
* Confirm that all protocol parameters (e.g., storage conditions, pull points, test plans) are correctly entered and consistent with both quotes and client\-provided documents.
* Verify compliance with GMP, internal SOPs, and industry guidelines.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or gaps and communicate effectively with Protocol Writers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Ensure documentation is traceable, audit\-ready, and maintained in accordance with data integrity principles (ALCOA\+).
* Support continuous improvements in review workflows, documentation standards, and system utilization.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications Required:**
* Master’s degree in a scientific discipline (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field) or equivalent industry with 4\-6 years of experience.
* Experience or familiarity with GMP, data integrity expectations, and regulated laboratory environments.
* Ability to learn and work effectively within LIMS or similar informatics systems.
* Strong scientific comprehension and ability to interpret technical protocols, quotes, and study plans.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to constructively collaborate and provide clear feedback.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Key Candidate Attributes**
* Self\-motivation; excellent quality of work and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and internal/external clients
* Ability to learn new tasks quickly and to move easily from task to task
* Ability to handle prioritization and multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to use a personal computer and learn necessary programs
* Good communication skills (oral and written)
* Organizational ability and good judgement
* Science background/education and/or laboratory experience
* Strong Math Skills
* Logical Thinking, Good Reasoning Ability
* Motivation to excel
* Coaching/mentoring of peers

description:
**Company Description** 




 Bhoomi Process Management Pvt. Ltd., a sister concern of Bhoomi Analyzers, has been dedicated to manufacturing world\-class products for process industries since its inception in June 2006\. The company specializes in gas and liquid analyzers for applications in Process, Combustion, Emission, and Renewable Energy. Serving over 1,500 clients across sectors like power plants, oil \& refineries, pharmaceuticals, and research institutes, Bhoomi has demonstrated consistent growth exceeding 30% annually. With expertise in advanced technologies such as NDIR, UV\-DOAS, TDLAS, and FTIR, Bhoomi is recognized as a leader in its field and operates under ISO 9001:2015\-certified quality management standards.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Quality Control Engineer located in
 **Ambernath**
 . The Quality Control Engineer will oversee and perform quality control processes to ensure all products meet organizational and industry standards. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting inspections, performing quality assurance tests, analyzing data to identify areas for improvement, and optimizing quality processes. Additionally, the engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to address quality issues and maintain compliance with industry regulations while supporting the organization’s commitment to excellence.
 



  





**Job location: Ambernath**




  





**Qualifications** 



* Proficiency in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and Quality Management processes
* Strong Analytical Skills, including data interpretation and problem\-solving
* Effective Communication skills to collaborate with teams and document findings
* Experience in process industries or related fields preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field
* Familiarity with ISO 9001:2015 standards and regulatory compliance



  





**Department:** 
  Quality Control / Quality Assurance
 



**Reporting To:** 
  QC Manager / Quality Head
 



**Qualification:** 
  ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Instrumentation or related field (Freshers can apply)
 



**Experience:** 
  Fresher – 2 Years
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* **Incoming \& In\-Process Inspection:** 
  Perform incoming, in\-process, and final inspection of materials and finished products.
* **Testing:** 
  Conduct visual, dimensional, and functional testing as per product specifications.
* **Quality Documentation:** 
  Prepare and maintain inspection reports, test records, and quality documentation.
* **Non\-Conformance Handling:** 
  Raise Non\-Conformance Reports (NCR) for defective materials or products.
* **Corrective Actions:** 
  Support root cause analysis and assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* **ISO Compliance:** 
  Assist in maintaining ISO 9001 documentation and support internal or external audits.
* **Process Compliance:** 
  Ensure all inspection activities follow company SOPs and safety guidelines.
* **Cross\-Team Coordination:** 
  Coordinate with production, stores, and dispatch teams to resolve quality\-related issues.
* **Use of Measuring Instruments:** 
  Utilize measuring instruments such as Vernier, Multimeter, Micrometer, etc., for quality checks.
* **Reporting \& Analysis:** 
  Maintain accurate records and support quality analysis for continuous improvement.



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Basic knowledge of quality control tools and techniques.
* Understanding of measuring instruments (Vernier, Multimeter, Micrometer, etc.).
* Knowledge of ISO 9001 standards.
* Basic MS Excel and documentation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Greetings from P360\..!** 




  





**About us** 
 :
 



  





 P360 is an advanced pharma software company specializing in business technology development and implementation for pharmaceutical and life sciences companies worldwide. We specialize in technology that boosts operational efficiency across the entire organization while giving a unique view of how your internal process is functioning and how to improve them.
 



  





  





**Job Description** 




 We’re searching for an experienced technical writer to join our team and help take our customer/client\-focused services to new heights. As an ideal candidate, you have proven experience in a highly technical field, such as software development, computer science, engineering, and/or writing documentation in a regulated environment. You have the ability to evaluate and analyse complex information and a natural desire to help people understand things that are hard to understand.
 



  





**Objectives of This Role** 



* Strong writing and editing skills with meticulous attention to detail
* Deep understanding of regulatory requirements (FDA, ICH) for creating documentation in regulated environments
* Strong proficiency in MS Office tools, including Word, Visio, and SharePoint
* Ability to manage projects, collaborate effectively with subject matter experts (SMEs), and meet deadlines in high\-pressure pharma/biotech environments
* Develop comprehensive documentation that meets organizational standards
* Obtain a deep understanding of products and services to translate complex information into simple, polished, and engaging content
* Write user\-friendly content that meets the needs of the target audience, turning insights into language that sets users up for success
* Develop and maintain detailed databases of reference materials, including research, usability tests, and design specifications
* Evaluate existing content and develop innovative approaches for continuous improvement



  





**Daily and Monthly Responsibilities** 



* Research, outline, write, and edit new and existing content while working closely with cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements
* Independently gather information from subject matter experts to develop, organize, and write procedure manuals, technical specifications, and process documentation
* Work with development and support leads to identify documentation repositories, revise and edit existing content, and determine optimal solutions for data compilation and centralized storage
* Research, create, and maintain information architecture templates that uphold organizational and legal standards and enable easy data migration
* Develop content in alternative media formats for maximum usability, ensuring a consistent and cohesive voice across all documentation



  





**Skills and Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field
* 5\+ years of industry experience as an effective technical writer
* Experience writing documentation in a GxP environment and in support of validated applications, including requirements and design specifications, test protocols, validation plans, and validation reports
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations (GMP, GCP, GLP), FDA regulations, and compliance standards
* Meticulous attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
* Proven ability to quickly learn and understand complex topics
* Previous experience writing documentation and procedural materials for multiple audiences
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with a strong eye for detail
* Experience working with engineering teams to improve user experience, including design, UI collaboration, content refinement, and creation of visuals and diagrams for technical support content



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Proven ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously with effective prioritization
* Firm understanding of the systems development life cycle (SDLC)
* Previous software development experience
* Certification through the Society for Technical Communicators
* Experience using XML tools to create documentation



  





**Perks \& Benefits** 



* Permanent work\-from\-home opportunity
* Flexi Week culture (5 days / 9\-day fortnight)
* Fixed internet allowance
* Other benefits



  





  





  





  





**Note**
 : We will contact candidates who fit the current requirements. If you are not contacted, your information and resume will be kept in our database, so we can contact you when and if we have similar vacancies in the future.

* Regularly update documents based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, or new deployments
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Xmetal, Latex, Markdown or Sphinx
* Experience working in agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics


**Work Experience**
 Documentation, LaTeX, Git, Architecture \& Topology Diagrams, Visio, SCADA, Networking, Markdown

description:
**We test you by building. With AI. In the interview.** 




 Not a trick. Not a gotcha. We'll give you a real problem and ask you to solve it using whatever AI tools you want — Cursor, Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, all of it. We want to see how you think, how you use the tools, and how fast you ship. If that excites you, keep reading.
 



  





**What BlackScore does** 




 We build AI\-native intelligence platforms for law enforcement and national security agencies across 30\+ countries. Our systems fuse OSINT, SIGINT, financial records, dark web data, and video intelligence into actionable decisions at national scale. We compete against companies 100x our size and win because our tools work in reality, not demos.
 



 You won't be building another e\-commerce checkout flow. You'll be working on systems where the quality of your code has real\-world consequences.

 You graduated in 2025 or 2026 with a degree in Computer Science or a related field. You can code — language matters less than how you think. You've built something outside of class and can show us.  We're bootstrapped and profitable — no VC pressure, no pivot risk, no layoffs when the funding runs out. You'll work on problems that matter, with a team that trusts you to deliver. Singapore\-based, on\-site, real ownership from week one.

 Send your CV and GitHub (or anything you've built) to recruit@blackscore.ai or apply through Linkedin. Tell us in three sentences why you want to build intelligence platforms, not SaaS dashboards.

description:
**Fieldpiece Instruments**, a privately held US company, is hiring a **Human Resources Business Partner** to open our new office in Hyderabad, Telangana. Reporting to the CHRO in the US, you’ll be the first and only HR professional in India and be responsible for building this office from the ground up – managing the office, working with a local service firm for payroll and compliance, and partnering with US\-based managers to hire 20\+ high\-caliber technical professionals in the first year. This is a founding HR Business Partner opportunity.


If you’ve successfully built and scaled India operations for a US\-based company before — and know exactly what “day zero to structured growth” looks like — we want to speak with you. This role is ideal for a confident, strategic, execution\-focused HR leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure, and enjoys partnering across time zones.
Fieldpiece is a thriving team of innovators \- committed to pushing boundaries and celebrating curiosity. We’ve been providing HVACR professionals with rugged, feature\-rich tools like meters, manifolds, leak detectors, and more since 1990\. Fieldpiece leads the industry in the way we think, work, collaborate, and remain laser\-focused on creating products that empower HVACR professionals – today and tomorrow.

* Act as a trusted advisor to the US\-based CHRO and leadership team – aligning India talent strategy with global business objectives
* Implement HR systems and processes




**Scale the Hyderabad Team*** Participate in workforce planning with US and India leadership to hire \~22 professionals in the first year (engineering, software, QA, technical roles)
* Build strong recruiting pipelines and employer branding locally
* Drive structured onboarding and performance processes
* Establish a high\-performance, inclusive culture and drive engagement initiatives and retention strategies
* Coach managers and leaders and serve as the go\-to HR partner for all employee relations matters

**What You Bring*** 10\+ years in HR, including senior HR Business Partner or HR Leader roles
* Proven experience building or scaling India operations for a US or multinational company with a focus on engineering or technology
* Expertise in Telangana employment law and statutory compliance
* Experience managing a new office and HR operations as the sole HR leader
* Fluent, professional English (written and verbal)
* Experience with Workday or other global HCM platforms


**Our values drive everything we do and our culture.**
**We are a TRIBE.*** Our collective growth starts with individual growth.
* We are fully engaged and empowered, collaborating to achieve our common mission.
* Our people are central in making Fieldpiece the best place we will work, ever.

* We address obstacles head\-on with creativity, grit and tenacity, while having fun along the way.

* Our culture of purposeful critical thinking leads to greatness now, rather than perfection never.


**We earn TRUST.*** We prove our credibility, reliability, and genuine interest in others to build lasting relationships.
* Our tribe, partners, end users, suppliers and channel partners can rely on us to listen, act with integrity, and deliver quality.


**We are LEAN.*** We never stop searching for a better way.

title: Senior Workday Solution Architect - Global HR (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


This role sits within the **Digital Transformation function of the People \& Organization department**. You will design scalable HR system architectures, lead global system and vendor transitions, and ensure our HR technology landscape remains compliant, future\-ready, and aligned to our operating model.



You will design scalable HR system architectures, service delivery \& operating models, lead global system and vendor transitions, and ensure our HR technology landscape remains compliant, future\-ready, and aligned to our operating model.



This is a **1\-year fixed\-term role**, based in **Gurugram (hybrid model)**, our India hub, covering a global scope.


**About the Role**


* **Automation:** Strong hands\-on experience in Scripting process/task automations using niche technologies like UiPath StudioX, Power Automate, Python, GenAI LLMs and ability to build API/SFTP integrations and building middleware solutions
* **Solution Architecture Design:** Analyze HR processes \& system landscape reviews using BPMN \& lean methodologies, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable to\-be processes and HR Tech system landscapes
* **Tech Evaluation \& Adoption**: Scout emerging HR technology solutions and partner with FlixTech to design workflows, evaluate integration options (APIs, SFTP, etc.) and build system architecture designs. Create data\-driven business cases for project budget allocation.
* **Technical Project Delivery**: Lead delivery of high\-impact global HR Tech projects with multiple workstreams (scope, plan, RAID, benefits, budgets, vendors) and building risk management frameworks using Jira
* **Project Reporting \& Governance:** Maintain BPMN process documentation, embed processes in HR service delivery model, run project governance \& stakeholder bodies, set internal control points \& risk frameworks, compliance and data privacy frameworks as per internal and external regulatory standards


**About You**


* **7\+ years of experience in HR Tech transformation** as a Senior Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or RPA Automation Developer
* Strong hands\-on experience delivering global **Workday architecture implementations**, system redesigns, or HRIS architecture transformations (Workday is mandatory)
* Experience with system architecture redesigns, integrations (API, SFTP, middleware), cloud environments, and data flows
* Proven experience driving global HR tech initiatives with multi\-country stakeholders in vendor\-heavy ecosystems
* Hands\-on Jira portfolio management, Confluence documentation, BPMN modelling, test strategy design (SIT/UAT)
* University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, HR Tech, or related field
* Certifications in architecture, RPA, Automation or project management (PMP / SAFe / Scrum / Six Sigma/UiPath or similar)


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 30 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Intern
description:
**At Pitney Bowes, we do the right thing, the right way. As a member of our team, you can too.**

  

We have amazing people who are the driving force, the inspiration and foundation of our company. Our thriving culture can be broken down into four components: **Client. Team. Win. Innovate.**


We actively look for prospects who:  

* Are passionate about client success.
* Enjoy collaborating with others.
* Strive to exceed expectations.
* Move boldly in the quest for superior and best in market solutions.
**Job Description:**

**Join Pitney Bowes as Intern**

**Years of Experience required\- Fresher**

**Job Location\-Noida**

**Impact**


We are looking for a highly motivated **Intern**/Associate who will contribute to building and enhancing our enterprise\-grade software applications. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about writing high\-quality code, building scalable systems, and leveraging cloud technologies to solve complex business problems.


**The Job**

* Participate in requirement analysis and technical design discussions for new features and platform enhancements.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable backend services and APIs.
* Write clean, modular, and well\-documented code following software engineering best practices.
* Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and third\-party systems.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and Architecture teams to deliver high\-quality features.
* Work on API\-first and cloud\-native applications.
* Contribute to database design, optimization, and query development.
* Assist in containerization and deployment of applications to cloud platforms.
* Debug and troubleshoot production issues while ensuring performance and scalability.

**Qualifications \& Skills required**

* UG \- B.Tech/B.E. OR PG – M.S. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline.
* Knowledge of at least one Object oriented programming language like Java(spring\-boot, web services, multithreading).
* Basic knowledge of DB and SQL Queries (preferably mySQL)
* Knowledge of any cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus
* Knowledge of API Testing tool is required like postman, SoapUI etc.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes is a plus.
* Knowledge of Agile framework is a plus
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast paced, changing environment
* Strong customer focus, excellent problem solving, and analytical skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills

**About Pitney Bowes**


Pitney Bowes (NYSE:PBI) is a global technology company providing commerce solutions that power billions of transactions. Clients around the world, including 90 percent of the Fortune 500, rely on the accuracy and precision delivered by Pitney Bowes solutions, analytics, and APIs in the areas of ecommerce fulfillment, shipping and returns; cross\-border ecommerce; office mailing and shipping; presort services; and financing. For 100 years Pitney Bowes has been innovating and delivering technologies that remove the complexity of getting commerce transactions precisely right. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at https://www.pitneybowes.com/in.

**We will:**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(****P****B Live Well**)


Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Process Trainee
description:
**1\. Answering Inbound Customer Calls**

Answering incoming customer calls is the primary responsibility of a call center employee at the entry level\-position of inbound call centers. When receiving inbound calls, they must provide accurate information about a company’s offerings, answer questions from prospects or current customers, resolve basic issues, and manage account inquiries.

An inbound call center representative may also be responsible for processing orders and payments, resolving billing and payment issues, managing cancellations, shipping, refunds, returns, and warranties, and properly logging customer data after each customer interaction.

To efficiently handle the inbound call volume and deliver an exceptional customer service experience, they should know how to start and end a call, follow call scripts, put a customer on hold, and transfer a call when the customer’s issue needs escalation.

**2\. Managing Customer Complaints**

A call center job requires agents to effectively manage complaints and deal with unhappy customers. Therefore, agents should be trained and equipped to solve customer problems quickly and efficiently and defuse conflicts before they turn into more challenging situations.

Agents must be able to demonstrate excellent listening skills, empathy, problem\-solving, and properly apologize. They also should know how to seamlessly escalate the issue to higher\-tier support if it cannot be resolved immediately, or if an agent doesn’t have the appropriate skill set or authority.

**3\. Troubleshooting and Follow\-ups**

In IT, tech, and SaaS companies, call center representatives can be involved in troubleshooting and resolving technical support issues customers may have with a company’s product or service. That can also include performing diagnostic tests, troubleshooting software installations, and assisting with setting up product features. Since complicated tech issues aren’t always resolved on the first contact, agents may also need to follow up with customers and update them on the progress of their queries.

**4\. Making Outbound Calls**

In outbound call centers, agents initiate calls to leads, prospects, or customers, rather than accepting incoming calls. These calls can have specific purposes ranging from cold calling, telemarketing sales, and proactive support to scheduling appointments, gathering feedback, and conducting market research.

* **Lead generation and sales:** Agents make large volumes of outbound calls to generate leads or sell a company’s products or services to existing clients.
* **Proactive customer service:** Agents reach out to customers proactively to address existing or potential issues before they become bigger problems.
* **Conducting market research:** Agents make outbound calls to conduct market research and gather insights about market trends and consumer preferences.
* **Collecting customer feedback:** Agents can be responsible for calling up the customers to gather feedback about the products or services they purchased.
* **Appointment scheduling:** Agents may call potential customers to schedule appointments and events with a business.
* **Debt collection:** Agents call customers who have overdue payments to negotiate payment plans, collect debts, and resolve other financial disputes.

Most outbound call center operations and agent workflows can be optimized through call center dialing tools such as AI\-powered auto dialers. Call center dialers automate the dialing process and enable agents to handle high outbound call volumes while increasing agent talk times and reducing agent idle times.

**5\. Up\-Selling and Cross\-Selling**

Up\-selling and cross\-selling are also among the common call center duties. During customer service interactions, agents can encourage customers to purchase a higher\-end version of a product or service they are already using (up\-sell) or offer a related or complementary product or service (cross\-sell). To do it efficiently, professionally, and in a non\-intrusive way, agents should have deep product knowledge and be able to communicate its benefits to customers.

**Note: Candidates who can speak English \+ Tamil/Hindi/Malayalam are only eligible to apply**

**Overview**
 Are you excited by the idea of shaping how Microsoft builds and operates cloud services at global scale? In this role, you will join a team at the heart of Microsoft Azure, helping power the operational framework that every Microsoft cloud service and engineering tool depends on. You will contribute to a company\-wide platform that includes the software inventory system integrated with Microsoft’s internal engineering ecosystem, along with an operational intelligence solution that delivers a complete, 360\-degree view of the security, privacy, compliance, and reliability of every piece of software Microsoft ships. Your work will directly enable the company to deliver secure, resilient, and trusted cloud services to millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will work alongside a highly skilled, collaborative, and fast\-moving team that thrives on solving complex problems, iterating quickly, and delivering meaningful business value. You will work with modern Azure services and data technologies to build scalable, innovative, and impactful solutions that sit at the core of Microsoft’s cloud. This role will accelerate your technical growth, strengthen your engineering fundamentals, and give you opportunities to think creatively and influence systems used across the company.
   

  

 You will join a culture grounded in inclusivity, diverse perspectives, empathy, trust, and shared ownership. Your ideas will matter, your voice will be heard, and your work will help shape products and experiences that enable Microsoft and its customers to achieve more every day.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

title: Organization Development (OD) Manager
description:
**Business Overview \-** 




  





***About Danone Group:***




  





 Mission: Bringing Health through Food to as Many people as Possible
 



  





 Danone is a global leader in food and beverages, focusing on Essential Dairy and Plant\-based products, Waters, and Specialized Nutrition. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible by creating nutritious products, raising awareness about healthy eating and drinking habits, and conducting our business sustainably.
 



  





 Danone’s dual focus on commercial performance and societal responsibility, combined with an ongoing commitment to innovation and the strengthening of its health\-oriented brands, has resulted in strong performance worldwide. With nearly 90,000 employees and products sold in over 120 markets, Danone has generated more than €27 billion in sales annually.
 



  





 More information can be found at www.danone.com.
 



  





***About Danone India:***




  





 India is among the countries in the APAC zone wherein Danone has its presence. Danone operates in India as Nutricia International Pvt. Ltd, focusing on nutrition with a range of products catering to pregnant mothers, infants, young children as well as adults. These products are manufactured in India and sold nationally under recognized brands such as Aptamil, Dexolac, Nusobee, and Protinex. Danone employs over 1,000 individuals across India and generates a turnover exceeding €170 million. The company's head office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a manufacturing facility situated in Lalru, Punjab.
 



  





 Danone India is a Great Place To Work® certified organization, which reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where people are empowered to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and feel a true sense of belonging.
 



  





 More information can be found at https://www.danone.in/
 



  





 Want to learn more about Careers at Danone India? Visit Danone Careers
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities \-** 




  





 The OD Manager is responsible for driving organizational effectiveness by designing and implementing organization development initiatives that strengthen managerial capability, enhance culture, and enable change. The role partners closely with HRBPs and business leaders to support transformation, improve ways of working, and build future\-ready organizational capabilities aligned with Danone’s people strategy. The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution, with the ability to diagnose organizational challenges and translate them into practical, high impact interventions.
 



  





*Organizational Development \& Effectiveness:*



* Design and deliver organization development initiatives focused on organizational effectiveness, team effectiveness, and culture transformation.
* Conduct organizational diagnostics (qualitative and quantitative) to assess organizational health, effectiveness, and readiness for change.
* Support organization design work including role clarity, governance, structure effectiveness, and ways of working.



  





*Change Management:*



* Lead and support change management initiatives linked to business transformation, restructuring, or strategic shifts.
* Build change capability within leaders and teams by providing frameworks, tools, and coaching.
* Ensure high adoption and sustainability of change initiatives.



  





*Leadership \& Capability Development:*



* Contribute to the design and deployment of managerial development programs in collaboration with Talent \& Learning.
* Facilitate leadership, team, and culture workshops to strengthen managerial and organizational capability.
* Coach managers on team dynamics, engagement, and performance effectiveness.



  





*Culture and Engagement:*



* Drive culture\-building initiatives aligned with Danone values and global people strategy.
* Partner with HRBPs to translate engagement insights into targeted OD actions.
* Support initiatives that foster continuous improvement, collaboration, and learning culture.



  





*Data, Diagnostics and Insights:*



* Leverage OD tools, diagnostics, and people data to identify themes, risks, and opportunities.
* Track effectiveness of OD interventions and continuously refine based on insights and feedback.



  





*Stakeholder and Project Management:*



* Work closely with HRBPs, COEs, and business leaders as a trusted OD partner.
* Manage multiple OD projects simultaneously with clear milestones, governance, and outcomes.
* Contribute to regional or global OD initiatives as required.



  





**Candidate Profile \-** 




  





***Qualifications \& Experience:***



* Postgraduate degree in HR, from a Tier 1 institute
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, with
 **strong exposure to OD, change management, and/or transformation roles** 
 .
* Experience partnering with senior leaders in a matrixed, multinational environment preferred.
* Prior facilitation and workshop delivery experience are essential.



  





***Skills and Capabilities***



* Organization Development \& Design
* Change Leadership \& Culture Transformation
* Strong Facilitation \& Coaching Skills
* Stakeholder Management
* Analytical Thinking \& Use of OD Diagnostics
* Project Management
* Strategic thinker with a hands\-on execution mindset
* Strong influencing and collaboration skills
* Comfortable with ambiguity and transformation
* High learning agility and resilience

 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of HR operations, contributing directly to Synopsys’ ability to attract, engage, and retain top talent.
* Enhance employee experience by streamlining and standardizing critical HR processes across the organization.
* Drive process harmonization and reduce operational variability, enabling scalable growth and business agility.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through clear, structured process documentation and improved process visibility.
* Support compliance and risk mitigation by ensuring HR processes adhere to regulatory and organizational standards.
* Empower business leaders and HR stakeholders with tools and resources to effectively manage people practices in a rapidly evolving environment.

* Extensive experience of 8\-10 years leading HR process design, transformation, and optimization initiatives across the full employee lifecycle.

* Proven ability to evaluate current\-state HR operations and architect scalable, future\-state processes that drive efficiency and compliance.
* Deep expertise in developing enterprise\-grade HR documentation, including process maps, SOPs, job aids, and toolkits.
* Demonstrated ability to drive process harmonization across multiple business units, regions, or legacy operating models.

* Advanced analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex workflows into clear, actionable documentation.

* Detail\-oriented, analytical, and highly organized, with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and resilient, able to navigate ambiguity and drive change in fast\-paced settings.

title: TA Coordinator Arabic - Hybrid (Ext and Int)
description:
**Overview**
 As a Recruitment Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring seamless execution of recruitment coordination processes across different hiring categories:
   

  

* Professional External \& Internal Hiring, Frontline Hiring, and Early Talent Hiring.
* You will be responsible for managing requisition processing, interview scheduling, offer management, pre\-boarding, and onboarding activities, while ensuring compliance, data integrity, and process adherence.
* This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.
* You will work closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, Talent Acquisition Leaders, and HR teams to deliver an exceptional recruitment experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.


**Responsibilities**
* Arabic language Required


**Recruitment Coordination \& Process Management**
* Requisition Management: Ensure accurate entry, updates, and maintenance of job requisitions within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Interview Scheduling \& Coordination: Manage and coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers to ensure timely and professional interview logistics.
* Offer \& Pre\-boarding Support:
+ Assist in the preparation and issuance of offer letters ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
+ Facilitate background checks, tracking progress, and resolving any related issues.

* Onboarding Coordination:
+ Support pre\-boarding activities, including new hire documentation and orientation scheduling.
+ Ensure a smooth transition for new hires, resolving any onboarding\-related concerns efficiently.

* Process Oversight: Monitor all aspects of the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring timely completion of each stage while maintaining high service standards.


**Data Management \& Reporting**
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records within the ATS and other recruitment systems.
* Ensure data integrity and compliance with company policies and data privacy regulations.
* Generate basic reports on recruitment activities, tracking process completion rates, candidate status, and coordination efficiency.


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Teams, and Candidates.
* Provide timely updates on the status of coordination activities, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
* Ensure candidates receive a high\-touch experience, keeping them informed throughout the interview and hiring process.


**Process Improvement \& Technology Utilization**
* Identify and suggest process improvements to streamline coordination activities and enhance efficiency.
* Utilize the ATS, CRM, and other recruitment tools to ensure timely and accurate execution of coordination activities.
* Stay updated on system and process changes, ensuring proper adoption and compliance.


**Compliance \& Process Adherence**
* Ensure all recruitment activities comply with local employment laws, company policies, and global hiring standards.
* Maintain accurate data entry and tracking within the ATS, ensuring full compliance with recruitment lifecycle protocols.
* Safeguard the accuracy and completeness of candidate records, ensuring adherence to data privacy regulations.


**Specialized Responsibilities Based On Coordination Type**
* Support both external and internal recruitment processes, managing job postings, candidate scheduling, and onboarding logistics across multiple hiring categories.
* Balance internal mobility coordination while handling external hiring logistics, ensuring dual\-process efficiency.
* Act as a central coordination point for roles requiring both external hiring and internal employee transitions.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s Degree and 2\+ years of experience in recruitment coordination, HR operations, or talent acquisition support.
* Talent Acquisition Technology Expertise: Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., iCIMS, Workday, SuccessFactors) and recruitment technologies.
* Organizational \& Time Management Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple priorities, high\-volume hiring processes, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Process \& Compliance Adherence: Understanding of global hiring standards, local employment laws, and recruitment lifecycle protocols to ensure compliance and data integrity.
* Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy in offer processing, scheduling, and data management to maintain seamless recruitment coordination.
* Collaboration \& Confidentiality: Ability to work collaboratively across teams while maintaining discretion in handling sensitive candidate information.
* Candidate Experience Management: Strong customer service orientation to ensure a high\-touch candidate experience throughout the interview and onboarding process.
* Proficiency in English: Strong written and spoken English skills to support recruitment coordination across regions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hybrid Coordination Expertise: Experience balancing both internal mobility coordination and external hiring logistics.
* HR Systems \& Data Management: Familiarity with recruitment workflows, HR processes, and system\-generated analytics to support reporting and insights.
* Process Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify opportunities for operational efficiency and suggest enhancements to streamline coordination activities.
* Internal Mobility Coordination: Experience managing job postings, interview logistics, and onboarding for both external hires and internal employee transitions.
